end.summary:
Neutralisation was practised: acid and base react to form salt and water, with heat released; easy questions were answered, but a why/new-situation check is still needed.
Indicators and dilution were practised. Khushi distinguished base addition from adding water in the box example, though this was not steady across earlier answers.
Daily-life uses were practised through ant bites, antacids, and other examples; application is still building.
Khushi first suggested that water neutralises acid, then later corrected this by distinguishing dilution from neutralisation.
end.parentNote: Asha practised neutralisation with Khushi using ant-bite treatment, heat, indicators, and dilution. Khushi used the acid-plus-base method to identify salt, water, and heat, and later distinguished adding a base from adding plain water; the earlier water mix-up was corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask Khushi to sort examples into “dilution” or “neutralisation” and give one reason for each.
